content: The autonomous-task-brain skill uses a standardized 5-stage closed-loop reusable workflow for task automation: Perceive (scan sessions for new/repeated/failed tasks) → Retrieve (search local skills, historical sessions, memory engines, GitHub for optimal solutions) → Decide (select execute/suggest/skip actions) → Execute (automatically create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts, or delegate subtasks) → Review (record results and update knowledge base for future improvements).
